reports.campanhas: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, segments.date, segments.ad_network_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.video_trueview_views FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '__START__' AND '__END__' ORDER BY segments.date
reports.criativos: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, ad_group_ad.ad.id, ad_group_ad.ad.type, ad_group_ad.status, segments.ad_network_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.video_trueview_views, metrics.trueview_average_cpv FROM ad_group_ad WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '__START__' AND '__END__'
reports.dispositivos: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, segments.device, segments.ad_network_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.video_trueview_views FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '__START__' AND '__END__'
reports.idade: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, ad_group_criterion.age_range.type, segments.ad_network_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.video_trueview_views FROM age_range_view WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '__START__' AND '__END__'
reports.genero: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, ad_group_criterion.gender.type, segments.ad_network_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.video_trueview_views FROM gender_view WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '__START__' AND '__END__'
reports.cidades: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, segments.geo_target_city, segments.ad_network_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.video_trueview_views FROM geographic_view WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '__START__' AND '__END__'
reports.dia_hora: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, segments.day_of_week, segments.hour, segments.ad_network_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.video_trueview_views FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '__START__' AND '__END__'
reports.formatos: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, segments.ad_network_type, metrics.video_trueview_views, metrics.trueview_average_cpv, metrics.video_trueview_view_rate_in_stream, metrics.video_trueview_view_rate_in_feed, metrics.video_trueview_view_rate_shorts, metrics.video_quartile_p25_rate, metrics.video_quartile_p50_rate, metrics.video_quartile_p75_rate, metrics.video_quartile_p100_rate FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '__START__' AND '__END__'

inventory.campaigns: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign.labels FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status IN ('ENABLED','PAUSED','REMOVED')
inventory.ads: SELECT campaign.id, ad_group.id, ad_group.name, ad_group.labels, ad_group_ad.ad.id, ad_group_ad.ad.name, ad_group_ad.ad.type, ad_group_ad.labels, ad_group_ad.ad.video_ad.video.asset, ad_group_ad.ad.video_ad.in_feed.headline, ad_group_ad.ad.video_ad.in_stream.action_headline, ad_group_ad.ad.video_responsive_ad.headlines, ad_group_ad.ad.video_responsive_ad.long_headlines, ad_group_ad.ad.video_responsive_ad.descriptions, ad_group_ad.ad.video_responsive_ad.videos, ad_group_ad.ad.demand_gen_video_responsive_ad.headlines, ad_group_ad.ad.demand_gen_video_responsive_ad.long_headlines, ad_group_ad.ad.demand_gen_video_responsive_ad.descriptions, ad_group_ad.ad.demand_gen_video_responsive_ad.videos, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.headlines, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.descriptions, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_display_ad.headlines, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_display_ad.long_headline, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_display_ad.descriptions FROM ad_group_ad WHERE campaign.status IN ('ENABLED','PAUSED','REMOVED') AND ad_group.status IN ('ENABLED','PAUSED','REMOVED') AND ad_group_ad.status IN ('ENABLED','PAUSED','REMOVED')
inventory.assets: SELECT asset.resource_name, asset.youtube_video_asset.youtube_video_id, asset.youtube_video_asset.youtube_video_title FROM asset WHERE asset.type = 'YOUTUBE_VIDEO'
